desc: 白底叠装主图、酒店风铺床实景、垂顺折口细节与套件构成图解分镜
leaf: 酒店铺床风床单四件套
name: 净雅酒店风铺床四件套款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼赢下点击，用挺括叠装交代整套床品的量感与洁净
让买家把自己那张床代入进来，一眼看到铺好之后的整体垂顺效果
用折口与走线的近景证明铺上之后的平整服帖，承接核心卖点
微距交代包边与走线的做工，把面料质感的不透明证据一次给足
把两种床型的套件并排摆出，替买家当场决定该买哪一档尺寸
一张图解讲清套件里有什么件、各件怎么铺，消除最后的下单疑虑

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF sweep for packshots, pale room-grey #E3E2E0 for bedroom scenes and the variant screen, one warm off-white board #F6F5F3 for the infographic card
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons in warm terracotta #E0763B only, no fill, no 3D, no pictograms with text
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio light, front key with a fill card, low skimming sweep to read the weave, gentle contact shadows only, no harsh specular
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium hotel-crisp home-textile visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale room-grey #E3E2E0, charcoal metal #34322F and one warm terracotta accent #E0763B; neutral bright soft studio lighting with a front key, a fill card and gentle contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one short headline and blank ruled label lines in deep charcoal #2D2D2D; single-weight thin-line icon style in the terracotta accent; clean high-end bedding photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale, centring and crisp drape rendering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no duvet, throw or mattress topper hiding the product
style.presentationRules: fabric always shown neatly folded or smoothly dressed, drape and hem rendered flat and crisp, stable scale of the bed group across the set, product centred or on a shared baseline
style.surfaceSystem: crisp dressed bedding on a bare made mattress #F2F3F4, matte seamless studio floor
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, one short headline placeholder plus blank ruled label lines, deep charcoal #2D2D2D, no dense body text
